examples.text: 如果只在内部强推改革，难免会伤感情。
examples.trans: Pushing reform purely internally is bound to bruise feelings.

examples.text: 第一次独立做策划，紧张也是难免的。
examples.trans: Feeling nervous on your first solo pitch is only natural.
